character.name: Idle
character.prompt: A single monster for a turn-based JRPG battle, full body, centered. Cute and warm Ghibli-like creature design, readable chunky silhouette, thick dark outline. No background, no ground, no shadow, no text, no extra characters, no weapons other than those described. A small round carved wooden doll like a folk toy. Light brown wood with visible grain, the head bigger than the body, a simple painted face (dot eyes, brownish pink cheeks), short stick arms and legs joined by round wooden pegs at the shoulders, hips and knees, a few small age cracks. Stiff wind-up-toy stance. Palette: #B37A55, #92552D, #523624, #D4B08A. 2D pixel art, classic 32-bit era style (16/32-bit JRPG, SNES and PlayStation 1 look), crisp square pixels, limited palette, flat shading with hard edges, no anti-aliasing, no smooth gradients, no 3D rendering.
